name: ipwho.is (ipwhois.io free IP geolocation endpoint)
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator (ipwhois.io) with public API documentation, published pricing/terms and a multi-year public track record; P051 final condition 3: ipwho.is is community tier.

reliability.justification: Network geolocation is approximate by nature (registry and routing derived); city level often disagrees with other providers (observed: Brisbane vs Sydney for 1.1.1.1).

error_markers.reason: ipwho.is: free endpoint daily limit reached (HTTP 429 'Rate limit exceeded', resets after 24 h)
ipwho.is: success:false in an HTTP 200 body (error message instead of a geolocation record)

geo.title: ipwho.is keyless IP geolocation (GET https://ipwho.is/{ip}): country, ASN/ISP, network operator domain
geo.notes: Quote: research record C0110 (free tier 'commercial use allowed', ipwhois.io pricing) and P051 final condition 3 ('commercial use allowed'). Free endpoint 1,000 requests/day per client IP; above it HTTP 429 {success:false, message:'Rate limit exceeded'} = QUOTA. Errors arrive as success:false + message in HTTP 200 bodies ('Reserved range', 'Invalid IP address') = ERROR, never an absence (P051 FC3). Coordinates, postal code and timezone are never kept (FC6).
